title: March Madness Model Manifest
description: Manifest describing which reference models or runtime configs the website can load, which feature set they require, and how predictions should be resolved.

default_model_id.description: Model identifier the website should load by default for the bracket and team pages.

models.description: List of website-visible models or runtime strategies.

modelEntry.title: Model Manifest Entry
modelEntry.description: A model option presented to the website user. This may be heuristic, precomputed, runtime-config, or TensorFlow.js in the future.

id.description: Stable model identifier used by the website and downstream artifacts.

name.description: Human-readable name displayed in model selection UIs.

type.description: High-level implementation class for the model.

seasons.description: Seasons this model can legally be used against in the website.

feature_set.description: Feature set required by the model. Null is acceptable for models like coin flip that use no team features.

prediction_format.description: How the website should resolve matchup predictions for this model.

description.description: Explanation shown in the UI to set user expectations.

model_url.description: Optional URL to a TensorFlow.js model.json or other hosted model artifact.

config_url.description: Optional URL to a runtime-config JSON artifact.

predictions_url.description: Optional URL to a precomputed season-specific matchup prediction table.
